data.body_html:
Combine the thrill of deep-sea fishing with the romance of a sunset cruise on a Marbella fishing sunset combo charter 2034. Depart from Puerto Banús for two hours of angling in the Mediterranean, then relax as the sun sinks behind La Concha. All inclusive from €749 for the whole boat.

Why book a fishing and sunset combo in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline offers calm waters and abundant fish, making it ideal for a half-day adventure. A combo charter lets you maximise your time on the water: fish when the sea is lively, then switch to cruising mode with drinks as the light turns golden. No rushing, no hidden costs.

  • Two activities in one trip – fishing then sunset drinks.
  • Depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella’s marina scene.
  • Skipper handles navigation, gear, and local knowledge.
  • Fits into a afternoon or early evening schedule.

Boats for your combo charter

Choose from our Tier A fleet – both are fast, stable, and well-equipped for fishing and cruising.

Both depart from Puerto Banús. Skipper, fuel, gear, drinks, snacks, and IVA included. Browse all Marbella boat charters for larger groups or different durations.

Fishing: what to expect

The fishing leg runs from Puerto Banús towards Cabopino or Cala del Faro, where the seabed drops off and fish gather. Your skipper sets up rods with bait and lures. Common catches include sea bass, bream, and mackerel. We encourage catch and release to keep the ecosystem healthy.

No experience needed – the skipper will show you the basics. All gear is provided. If you land something big, the crew will help you reel it in.

Sunset cruise: the best views

After fishing, the boat turns west towards Marbella Marina and the Golden Mile. As the sun drops, the sky turns orange and pink behind La Concha mountain. The skipper will anchor off Cabopino or Cala Cortés for a quiet drink. Soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava are all included.

This is the moment for photos, conversation, and unwinding. The return to Puerto Banús happens under the stars, with the marina lights reflecting on the water.

Pricing and inclusions

The 2-hour fishing charter costs €749 for the whole boat. Adding the 2-hour sunset cruise brings the total to €1,498 for 4 hours. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full trip
  • Fishing rods, reels, bait, and tackle
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

There are no extra fees. Contact us via WhatsApp to book your preferred date.

Best time for a fishing sunset combo in 2034

The combo works best from May to October, when sunset is after 20:00 and sea temperatures are warm. Fishing is productive in late afternoon, and the sunset cruise follows naturally. For other months, ask about private charters – we can adapt the schedule.

How to book

Booking is simple: message us on WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat choice. We’ll confirm availability and send a secure payment link. A deposit holds your slot, with the balance due on the day. See all experiences in Marbella for more ideas.
